title: PyLabRobot adds BMG VANTAstar reader driver and PreciseFlex vision
summary: PyLabRobot merged 11 PRs since Friday: a native-USB driver for BMG's VANTAstar plate reader, an IntelliGuide vision feature for the PreciseFlex arm, and force-sensed Z probing.

claims.text: v1 VANTAstar plate reader over native USB (#1574)
PreciseFlexVision: IntelliGuide vision server as an arm feature (#1564)
Failed PreciseFlex setup now hands the arm back and closes links (#1586)
VANTAstar driver tested on one reader only (luminescence); Linux/macOS untested

why_it_matters: Open drivers keep widening vendor-neutral coverage of readers and arms; follow-up to last week's CLARIOstar/PF400 work.

title: Danaher plans AI-powered autonomous lab at Abcam for antibody discovery
summary: Danaher announced its first AI-powered autonomous lab, at Abcam, intended to design, build and test affinity reagents such as antibodies. Scale-up is expected in early 2027.

claims.text: Announced 7 Oct 2026; hosted at Abcam's Cambridge site
Targets: up to 8x faster affinity-reagent discovery and up to 10x annual output (company targets, not results)
Closed loop is stated as intent; no baseline or data behind the 8x/10x targets; BioSpectrum shows 9 Oct

why_it_matters: A tools giant building its own closed loop; reagents, not small-molecule ADME, so DMPK transfer is indirect. Targets unproven.
query: Danaher Abcam autonomous lab AI antibody October 2026

title: Carterra and AstraZeneca to co-build lab-in-the-loop hardware and software
summary: Carterra and AstraZeneca will jointly develop hardware and software to generate standardized experimental data at scale for AI/ML-guided discovery. No terms, timelines or outputs were disclosed.

claims.text: Engineering and software teams work with AstraZeneca scientists and automation specialists
Dated 8 Oct by News-Medical; SelectScience lists 14 Oct

why_it_matters: Pharma pulling instrument vendors into data-standardization; binding data first, but ADME could follow (speculation).

title: Lilly TuneLab serves ADME prediction models to biotechs via federated learning
summary: Lilly's TuneLab offers biotechs ADME and toxicity prediction models built with federated learning, so partners need not share raw data. Not a new launch.

claims.text: Federated-learning design, ADME/PK/tox models; launched Sept 2025 (data-point counts unverified)

why_it_matters: Predictive ADME is the 'design' end of the loop, not automation itself; held as context for the deep dive.
query: Lilly TuneLab autonomous lab OR lab in the loop ADME
